measurement.source: Zumstein et al. 2004, J Exp Biol 207:3515-3522 (doi:10.1242/jeb.01181); male 0.81+-0.03 mg

scope: uniform mass scaling only; geometry/inertia/muscle force calibration is separate
finding: FlyMimic model total mass is 2.494 mg in its gram/mm/uN unit system, i.e. 2.2x the measured 1.13+-0.03 mg female and 3.1x the 0.81 mg male (Zumstein 2004). The upstream body is not mass-calibrated to either sex; any force/statement normalized to model weight inherits this bias until recalibrated.
